correctness.rationale: Cut vectors span every coordinate by the identity 2e_uv=delta(u)+delta(v)-delta({u,v}); uniform switching makes the center c*=1/2 feasible and optimal by convexity of the fixed-rho center set. Corollary 3.10 of Barahona--Mahjoub supplies ALL cycle inequalities and necessary edge bounds. At c*, odd cycle length l contributes ratio l/(l-2); even cycles and bounds contribute 1. Every shortest odd cycle is chordless. Hence global maximum gives the formula, including disconnected/bipartite cases. Inspected standard-library exact finite checker, which corroborates but does not prove arbitrary graph size.
